puzzle.hint: Deceptive craft wielded by Pharaoh's magicians — their staffs and ropes seemed to crawl before Moses
puzzle.arabicVerse: قَالَ بَلْ أَلْقُوا۟ ۖ فَإِذَا حِبَالُهُمْ وَعِصِيُّهُمْ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيْهِ مِن سِحْرِهِمْ أَنَّهَا تَسْعَىٰ
puzzle.verse: 20:66 - He said, "Rather, you throw." And suddenly their ropes and staffs seemed to him from their magic that they were moving [like snakes].
